description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Pyke''' submerges into water for 5 seconds, entering [[File:Ambush_3.png|20px|link=Stealth#Camouflage|An icon representing the keyword Camouflage]] [[:Stealth#Camouflage|camouflage]] and gaining [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] 45% (+ 2% per 1 Lethality) '''bonus''' movement speed that decays over the duration. Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Ghostwater Dive'' immediately.
description.text: Active: Pyke submerges into water for 5 seconds, entering camouflage and gaining  45% (+ 2% per 1 Lethality) bonus movement speed that decays over the duration. Attacking or casting abilities ends Ghostwater Dive immediately.

description2.raw: ''Enemy champions within 1500 units of '''Pyke''' are alerted of his presence and whether he can execute them with [[File:Pyke Death from Below.png|20xpx|border|link=Pyke#Death from Below|An icon for Pyke's ability Death from Below]] [[Pyke#Death from Below|Death from Below]].''
description2.text: Enemy champions within 1500 units of Pyke are alerted of his presence and whether he can execute them with Death from Below.

notes.raw: * When an enemy is alerted, sharks will circle underneath their feet while a sound will be played to them that changes based on health threshold. * Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup. * PENDING FOR TEST: While submerged, a unique visual indicator will appear above '''Pyke''' if there are enemy champions closer than 700 units but farther than 600 units.
notes.text:
